{{Field procedure|summary=Clear blocked refinery bins and cargo problems so mining can continue without losing valuable fragments unnecessarily.}}

Use this procedure when the refinery stops accepting useful fragments, completed tonnes do not move into cargo, or collectors are working but mining progress has stalled.

{{Draft warning}}

== Before you start ==

* Stop firing mining tools until the blockage is understood.
* Keep the ship in a safe position away from asteroid surfaces.
* Check whether the problem is refinery bins, cargo capacity, or the ignore list.

== Procedure ==

{{Procedure steps|
# Open the refinery and cargo information for the ship.
# Check whether the cargo hold has free space for a completed tonne.
# If cargo is full, make space before expecting the refinery to finish more tonnes.
# Review each refinery bin and identify unwanted partial resources.
# Vent or clear low-priority bins that are blocking the resources the run is keeping.
# If collectors keep refilling the same unwanted bins, use [[How to Ignore Unwanted Mining Commodities]].
# Resume collection only after at least one useful refinery path is clear.
}}

== Completion check ==

The procedure is complete when the refinery can accept useful fragments again and completed tonnes can transfer into cargo.

== Common problems ==

* '''Cargo is full:''' refinery bins cannot complete into cargo without space.
* '''Every bin contains a different partial resource:''' clear the lowest-priority bins and consider using a refinery with more bins for mixed mining.
* '''The same unwanted fragment keeps returning:''' ignore that commodity before continuing collection.
* '''A valuable partial bin is present:''' do not vent it unless the run plan has changed or it blocks something more important.
